basics.name: Starlett Olivas
basics.label: Addiction Counselor in Training & Experienced Caregiver
basics.summary: Compassionate and driven student pursuing a career in addiction counseling. Offering over five years of combined experience in high-pressure logistics and direct patient care. Committed to applying academic training in addiction studies and hands-on caregiving expertise to support individuals in recovery and contribute meaningfully to the community.

work.name: Licensed Electrical Contracting Firm
work.position: Electrical Operations & Office Manager / Field Support
highlights: Managed office operations, paperwork, dispatch logistics, and client communication for a California State Certified Electrician.
Handled all types of operational tasks and provided field support, adhering to safety protocols including hard hat and PPE compliance.
Received an official endorsement rating of 'A+ Top-Notch Candidate' from employer.

work.name: UPS
highlights: Managed high-volume, time-sensitive deliveries in a demanding, fast-paced environment.
Demonstrated exceptional reliability and punctuality, representing the company professionally.
Maintained accurate logs and documentation to ensure accountability for all assets handled.

work.name: Visiting Angels (Private / Home Care)
highlights: Delivered compassionate care and emotional support to vulnerable individuals, assisting with daily living activities and medication adherence.
Established trusting relationships with clients and families through active listening, empathy, and clear communication.
Monitored client well-being, documented observations, and reported significant behavioral or physical changes to family members and healthcare providers.

references.name: California State Certified Electrician & Electrical Firm Owner
references.reference: In my professional opinion as a Certified Electrician to the State of California, I find her to be an A+ top-notch candidate. She managed electrical firm office operations for 5+ years, handled all types of things, and would even put on a hard hat. Always helpful with a great attitude.

references.name: Steve
references.relationship: Field Operations Lead & Logistics Supervisor (3 Years Tenure)
references.reference: She has that same great attitude, a real go-getter who wants to work and is deeply family-oriented. Worked with us for three years on side repo and field operations.
